(2) A close-up view shows a black 'PASTA HUT' pizza box being opened by hands with white nail polish. Inside is a small personal pizza topped with visible oysters, scallops, and green zucchini slices, resting on a cardboard insert. (3) The scene shifts to a white tray containing golden-brown potato wedges, crispy fried chicken nuggets, and two dark, round buns. A can of Pepsi and a green can are visible on the table background. (4) The host takes a slice of pizza and brings it to his mouth, his facial expression shifting to one of intense flavor appreciation. Close-up shots highlight the juicy texture of the oyster and the fleshy white scallops on the cheese. (5) The host holds up two bottles of sauce with red caps, one labeled Hai Shan and the other Wu Wei. A background graphic showing crabs in a tank appears briefly behind him, creating a seafood restaurant atmosphere. (6) The red sauce is squeezed from the bottle onto the pizza slice in a slow, focused stream. The host gestures with his free hand while speaking enthusiastically, his eyes wide with comedic excitement. (7) A second male character in a black t-shirt enters the frame from the right. He takes a bite of the pizza, nods his head in approval, and smiles at the first host who is laughing loudly. (8) Large text overlays dominate the screen in the final shot, detailing the price of 259 dollars and a 'limited time' warning. Both men are visible in a medium full shot, waving and laughing at the viewer.
